# Bounds {#sec-bounds}

*This is a recipe for* pricing **bounds** — the range of prices consistent with a
set of calibration constraints (the IME 2022 methodology, @Mildenhall2022).
`Bounds` computes them; `AllocationBounds` and `PricingBounds` specialize to the
allocation and pricing questions. (If this grows, it splits into `07_01`,
`07_02`, … without disturbing its neighbors.)
